sentences.en: Mr Brown contracted with the builder for a new house.
sentences.zh: 布朗先生与一位建筑商签订了新建房屋的合同。

sentences.en: You should have your house built by a trustworthy builder.
sentences.zh: 你应该找一个值得信赖的建筑商来建造你的房子。

sentences.en: I'm going to work as a builder with my father.
sentences.zh: 我要和我父亲一起做建筑工。

senses.zh: 建设者，建筑者,创建者,经营建筑业者,增洁剂，促净剂
